Set loop/repeat mode

Usage: wayle media loop <MODE> [PLAYER_ID]

Arguments:
  <MODE>
          Loop mode

          Possible values:
          - none:     No looping
          - track:    Loop current track
          - playlist: Loop entire playlist

  [PLAYER_ID]
          Player identifier (number or partial name match)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
